queries: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(ili.product_price) AS mean_product_price, COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_item_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_product_price) AS average_invoice_mean_product_price, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice FROM invoice_stats;

assumptions.assumption: The line-item count averages across all invoices, including invoices with zero line items; invoices without a non-missing price are skipped only for the price average.

assumptions.assumption: All rows in Invoices count toward the line-item average; invoices with no line items contribute zero. Invoices with no non-missing product_price are skipped by the price average.

responses.sql: WITH invoice_stats AS (SELECT i.invoice_number, AVG(li.product_price) AS mean_price, COUNT(li.invoice_number) AS line_count FROM Invoices AS i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS li ON li.invoice_number = i.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number) SELECT AVG(mean_price) AS average_invoice_mean_price, AVG(line_count) AS average_line_items_per_invoice FROM invoice_stats WHERE mean_price IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: An invoice with no non-missing product_price is excluded from both averages; line items with missing prices still count toward its line count.

alternatives.interpretation: Skip invoices without a price only for the price average; include every invoice, including those with zero line items, in the line-count average.
